excluded_attempts.reason: The inner monitor reported cc1 PID 332772 during the eleventh cell warmup. The outer trace did not observe that PID or interference. Exclude the entire cell from its worktree creation and retry with fresh artifacts; retain the ten fully audited completed cells.

system_cpu.scope: Each accepted command is covered by one uninterrupted, validated monitor interval. The interrupted cell was restarted from fresh artifacts on the same host.

log_reanalysis.reason: Cargo status and completion messages can occur after a partial libtest line in merged stdout/stderr.
log_reanalysis.scope: Only diagnostic Cargo status counts and early-test log classifications changed. Timings, test counts, process observations, and the original archived reports are unchanged.

session.description: Constructed workflow: warm workspace library tests, apply the published direct uv edit, and rerun workspace library tests. This is not a recorded developer session. Tests run serially within each executable to avoid the certificate-environment race in uv-client; Cargo may still overlap executables with compilation.
